# Security

Do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately
through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg-sync-engines/security/advisories/new).
Critical problems are fixed promptly, with the WordPress Security Team
where needed, even though the plugin is experimental.

This repository is not part of the
[WordPress bug bounty](https://hackerone.com/wordpress). Only the latest
release and `trunk` receive fixes.
